_comment: Template for .claude/launch.json, which setup.sh generates per checkout with that checkout's ports (see dev-ports.sh). Edit this file, not the generated one — a regenerate overwrites it. __API_PORT__ and __VITE_PORT__ are substituted from .env.

configurations.name: app
runtimeArgs: set -a; [ -f .env ] && source .env; set +a; exec uv run uvicorn prospector_app.backend.app:app --port "${API_PORT:-__API_PORT__}" --log-level warning
